audience: Third-year computer science instructors grading a course project.
objective: Present the Forge presentation compiler: what it does today, what it measured, what is planned.
sourcePack: Implemented: six-recipe intent-to-scene compiler; deterministic output (byte-identical recompiles); preservation of customized geometry; detached-slide authority. Measured: 26/26 V2 tests green; full suite 877/878 with one pre-existing locale failure. Planned (not built): full recipe families; agent runtime; browser editor beyond demo. Limitation: process/comparison cards span full content height with sparse content.
requiredClaims: Full recipe families are planned, not built
requiredEvidence: at least one measured test count
nuance: Implemented vs planned must stay visually and verbally distinct. A deck that presents the roadmap as shipped fails.
deterministicChecks: planned items absent from shipped-behavior claims
